item.title: Fitzroy Culture Guide: Galleries, Street Art and Live Music
item.description: Fitzroy has been Melbourne’s creative engine for decades. Not because anyone planned it that way, but because cheap rent in old warehouses attracted artists, musicians moved in after them, and eventually a whole culture grew up around the idea that making things matters more than making money. The rent isn’t cheap anymore — that ship sailed years ago — but the infrastructure those earlier generations built is still standing, and it still works.
